about: Damaged items (T14.65, docs/sync-spec.md 17.8): the banner, Details, Repair from sync and the one refusal line. Draft copy for the owner. Read by the desktop's tests (damage_tests.rs) and the UI (ipc/damagedCopy.ts). Shipped with the app: public copy only. {count} and {percent} are filled with numbers; kinds have one and many forms in the order Details lists them.
banner: Some items on this computer are damaged.

parts.one: 1 part of a meeting (a line, speaker, note or summary)
parts.many: {count} parts of meetings (lines, speakers, notes or summaries)

repair_intro: Repair reads everything from the sync server again, so damaged items can be replaced by good copies from your other computers. Nothing is removed or sent.
no_repair_sync_off: Turn sync on to repair them from your other computers. This computer can't repair them on its own yet.
nothing_healable: The sync server has no good copies of the rest, so they stay as they are for now.
kind_off_voice: Saved voice data doesn't sync now. Turning on voice sync on the Sync page lets Repair fix it.
kind_off_words: Dictionary words don't sync now. Turning on Dictionary sync on the Sync page lets Repair fix them.
result_some: Repair fixed what it could. These are still damaged:
repair_reading_start: Reading everything from the sync server again...
repair_reading: Reading everything from the sync server again: {percent}%.
repair_stopped: Repair is waiting because sync has stopped. The Sync page says why.
result_none: Repaired. Nothing damaged is left on this computer.
refusal: This can't be done because some items on this computer are damaged.
